card.name: Colour range in solution appearance
card.fires_on: The word "to" in "colorless to pale yellow" when a label describes how a clear or opalescent solution should look before use. It also fires on "a" in "should be a clear to" in the same setting.

modes.label: Colorless to yellow
modes.description: The word "to" joining colorless and a yellow shade in an appearance check.
modes.example: BENLYSTA should be clear to opalescent and colorless<< to>> pale yellow.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are forms of "pour", so the pole does not clearly add anything for this text.
card.plain: It marks the "to" in the standard description of a solution as colorless to pale yellow.
